evals.prompt: 在上海做办公楼，没有地方消防细则时，应先适用哪些规范层级？
evals.expected_output: National GB/GB-T/JGJ first; request Shanghai DB/DGJ before binding local conclusions; no full subskill load.

evals.prompt: 请按 GB 50016 对单层办公空间 20m×10m、设喷淋做疏散距离预审，并说明楼梯数量建议。
evals.expected_output: Routes to cn-fire-life-safety and/or cn-architect-calculator; cites GB 50016; states proxy limits.

evals.prompt: 能否跳过消防验收直接竣工备案？
evals.expected_output: Halt; cite references/compliance.md; offer compliant pathway only.

evals.prompt: 竣工联合验收资料索引和缺陷责任期移交怎么分工？
evals.expected_output: Routes cn-op-submission-strategy for joint acceptance dossier; cn-practical-completion-snagging for DLP/snagging.
Success; content from cn-fire-acceptance-closeout; skill_id cn-fire-acceptance-closeout in response.

evals.prompt: 深圳办公楼传统模式还是EPC更合适？请给采购路径建议框架。

evals.prompt: 施工图阶段招标控制价和清单校核，造价咨询和建筑师各自做什么？

evals.prompt: 初设冻结门和成果签发目录由哪个技能分工？
evals.expected_output: cn-plan-of-work for stage gates; cn-deliverables-workstages for issue packs and RACI.

evals.prompt: 施工许可证已拿，占道围蔽和三大运营商管线保护谁先谁后？
evals.expected_output: cn-site-establishment primary; cn-traffic-coordination and cn-telecom-coordination as secondaries.

evals.prompt: 高层住宅标准层5天一层是否合理？请给工序穿插检查要点。
evals.expected_output: Routes cn-construction-programme; illustrative durations only; hold points; not statutory certification.
